techs.name: Farming
uniques: Starting tech

civilopediaText.text: The first fields of grain, tilled by the tribes that would become the nations of Azeroth.

techs.quote: Feed the village first. Glory can wait until the harvest is in. — a Westfall farmer

techs.name: Pottery
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Clay vessels to store food and water through the long winters.

techs.quote: A clay jar holds more than grain. It holds the winter we survived. — Tauren saying

techs.name: Beast Taming

civilopediaText.text: Taming wolves, kodo, boars and the other beasts of the wild.

techs.quote: The wolf is not your servant. It is your brother, and it will judge you. — Durotan

techs.name: Archery
uniques: [-50]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: The bow, first weapon of the hunter and the ranger.

techs.quote: Breathe out. Let the moon guide the arrow. — Sentinel training lesson

techs.name: Mining
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Digging copper and tin from the hills, as the dwarves of Khaz Modan do best.

techs.quote: Dig deep enough and the mountain tells you its secrets. Dig too deep and it tells you something else. — Ironforge miner

techs.name: Sailing
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Boats and rafts to fish the coasts and cross to the islands.

techs.quote: The sea gives, and the sea takes. Respect her, and she gives a little more. — Kul Tiran tidesage

techs.name: Herbalism
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Knowing Peacebloom from Silverleaf: the first remedies and reagents.

techs.quote: Peacebloom for the body, silverleaf for the mind, and patience for everything else. — Cenarion herbalist

techs.name: Runic Script
uniques: Enables establishment of embassies <Civilopedia link [Tutorials/Embassies]>

civilopediaText.text: Writing in runes, as the titans' servants first taught the dwarves and the trolls.

techs.quote: The titans wrote the world in runes. We are only learning to read. — Brann Bronzebeard

techs.name: Skinning
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Turning hides and furs into leather.

techs.quote: Waste nothing the hunt gives you. The Earth Mother is watching. — Tauren hunter

techs.name: The Wheel
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Carts and wagons to carry goods between villages.

techs.quote: Round, it rolls. Square, it does not. This is the whole of engineering. — Gnomish primer, first page

techs.name: Masonry

civilopediaText.text: Cutting and stacking stone into walls and halls.

techs.quote: A wall is only as strong as the hands that laid it and the hearts that guard it. — Stromgarde stonemason

techs.name: Bronze Working
uniques: [+50]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Alloying copper and tin into bronze for tools and blades.

techs.quote: Copper and tin, fire and hammer. From such humble things, kingdoms are made. — Dwarven smith

techs.name: Optics
uniques: Enables embarkation for land units

civilopediaText.text: Lenses and spyglasses, for sailors and astrologers alike.

techs.quote: Look further, and you will see your enemy before he sees you. — Farstrider proverb

techs.name: Riding
uniques: [+50]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Riding horses, wolves and other mounts to war.

techs.quote: A good mount will carry you through fire. A bad one will carry you into it. — Stormwind stablemaster

techs.name: Mathematics

civilopediaText.text: Numbers and geometry, the tools of builders and engineers.

techs.quote: Numbers do not lie. Accountants, however... — Goblin trade prince

techs.name: Construction
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Timber frames, arches and bridges.

techs.quote: Build it to last a thousand years, and it might survive the next war. — Alliance engineer

techs.name: Philosophy

civilopediaText.text: Thinking about the Light, the spirits and the nature of the world.

techs.quote: Before you can command the arcane, you must first command yourself. — Archmage Antonidas

techs.name: Bardic Lore

civilopediaText.text: Songs and stories that keep the memory of a people.

techs.quote: Sing of the fallen, so that the living remember why they fight. — Darnassian lorekeeper

techs.name: Coinage
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Copper, silver and gold coins to pay for goods and soldiers.

techs.quote: Gold is the only language every race speaks fluently. — Steamwheedle Cartel motto

techs.name: Engineering
uniques: Roads connect tiles across rivers
[+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Aqueducts, cranes and siege machines.

techs.quote: If it explodes, it was a learning experience. If it doesn't, it was a success. — Gelbin Mekkatorque

techs.name: Iron Forged Swords
uniques: [-50]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Forging iron blades, the first of the blacksmith's great upgrades.

techs.quote: Iron does not care who swings it. Make sure it is you. — Orc blademaster

techs.name: Priesthood

civilopediaText.text: An ordered clergy, like the Church of the Holy Light or the Sisterhood of Elune.

techs.quote: The Light asks only that we remain steadfast. It is enough, and it is everything. — Northshire priest

techs.name: Arathi Law
uniques: Enables Open Borders agreements <Civilopedia link [Tutorials/Open Borders]>
[+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: The laws of the Arathi Empire, first human nation, that let a realm be ruled from afar.

techs.quote: A kingdom of laws outlives any king. — Thoradin, first King of Arathor

techs.name: Trade Guilds
uniques: Enables conversion of city production to [Gold]

civilopediaText.text: Guilds of craftsmen and merchants, like the Stonemasons' Guild of Stormwind.

techs.quote: One merchant is a target. A hundred merchants are a guild, and guilds have guards. — Stormwind trade charter

techs.name: Blacksmithing
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: The anvil and the forge: casting and hammering metal into weapons and armour.

techs.quote: Strike while the iron is hot, and strike again while it is cooling. — Thorium Brotherhood smith

techs.name: Seafaring
uniques: [-50]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: The compass and the charts that take ships across the Great Sea.

techs.quote: Beyond the horizon lie new lands, old enemies and better fishing. — Booty Bay captain

uniques: Enables conversion of city production to [Science]
Enables Research agreements <Civilopedia link [Tutorials/Research Agreements]>
[+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Schools and academies where the young learn from the old.

techs.quote: Knowledge hoarded is knowledge lost. Share it, and it multiplies. — Lorewalker Cho

techs.name: Animal War Training
uniques: Enables Defensive Pacts <Civilopedia link [Tutorials/Defensive Pacts]>

civilopediaText.text: Training horses and beasts to stand firm in battle, an upgrade of the Warcraft II stables.

techs.quote: The kodo does not fear the arrow, so neither should its rider. — Tauren war chief

techs.name: Clockwork
uniques: Improves movement speed on roads

civilopediaText.text: Springs, gears and escapements, the first steps toward gnomish engineering.

techs.quote: Wind it up, set it down, and stand well back. — Gnomish tinker

techs.name: Siege Engineering

civilopediaText.text: Counterweights and torsion: the science behind the catapult and the ballista.

techs.quote: Every wall has a weakness. Usually it is the gate. — Horde siege master

techs.name: Steel Forged Swords
uniques: [-50]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Steel blades, the second of the blacksmith's great upgrades.

techs.quote: Steel holds an edge. So must the warrior who carries it. — Varian Wrynn

techs.name: Astronomy
uniques: [+1] Movement <for [Embarked] units>
Enables [Embarked] units to enter ocean tiles
[+50]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Charting the stars and the two moons of Azeroth.

techs.quote: The stars are the oldest map of all. The night elves have been reading it for ten thousand years. — Tyrande Whisperwind

techs.name: Choral Hymns
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Choirs and great halls built to carry the sound of song and prayer.

techs.quote: When a thousand voices sing to the Light, even the dead stop to listen. — Cathedral of Light chorister

techs.name: Banking
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Banks and letters of credit, as in the vaults of Stormwind and the Undermine Exchange.

techs.quote: Deposit your gold with us and sleep soundly. We certainly will. — Gadgetzan banker

techs.name: Inscription
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: The scribe's craft: inks, glyphs, scrolls and printed books.

techs.quote: A glyph is a spell that waits patiently. — Dalaran scribe

techs.name: Blackpowder
uniques: [-50]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: The dwarves' explosive powder, which made the first guns and cannons possible.

techs.quote: Point the loud end at the enemy. — Ironforge rifle drill, lesson one

techs.name: Navigation

civilopediaText.text: Navigators who sail by the stars far out of sight of land.

techs.quote: A Kul Tiran never gets lost. We simply discover new places we did not intend to visit. — Daelin Proudmoore

techs.name: Architecture

civilopediaText.text: Grand halls, towers and cathedrals.

techs.quote: Build a spire high enough and the gods themselves will notice. — Quel'Thalas architect

techs.name: Auctioneering
uniques: [+50]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: The auction houses, where any good can find its price.

techs.quote: Going once, going twice... sold to the goblin in the back with too much gold! — Auction House barker

techs.name: Mithril Forged Swords
uniques: [-50]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Mithril blades, the finest of the blacksmith's upgrades.

techs.quote: Mithril is light as a feather and hard as a dragon's scale. It is also very expensive. — Dwarven armorer

techs.name: Alchemy
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Transmuting metals and brewing potions and flasks.

techs.quote: Every potion is a question. Some answer it. Some explode. — Royal Apothecary Society

techs.name: Archaeology
uniques: [+50]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Digging up the past, as the Explorers' League does across the world.

techs.quote: Every ruin is a letter from the past. Most are complaints. — Harrison Jones

techs.name: Arcane Science
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Studying magic as a science rather than an art, in the manner of Dalaran.

techs.quote: Magic is not a mystery. It is a discipline. — Jaina Proudmoore

techs.name: Steamworks
uniques: [+50]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Steam engines driving forges, mills and machines.

techs.quote: Steam, gears and a little bit of fire. What could possibly go wrong? — Goblin engineer

techs.name: Long Rifles
uniques: [-50]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: The dwarves' long-barrelled rifles, which extend a rifleman's reach.

techs.quote: Aim small, miss small. — Gilnean marksman

techs.name: War Doctrine

civilopediaText.text: Officers, drill and strategy: the study of war itself.

techs.quote: Plans survive until the first arrow flies. Prepare anyway. — Anduin Lothar

techs.name: Soil Enrichment
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Alchemical fertilisers and better farming for growing cities.

techs.quote: Feed the land, and the land feeds you. Poison it, and you starve together. — Cenarion druid

techs.name: Natural Lore
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: The druids' understanding of plants, beasts and the living world.

techs.quote: The forest remembers every footstep. Walk lightly. — Malfurion Stormrage

techs.name: Storm Hammers
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: The Wildhammer's storm hammers, which call down lightning, and the study of that power.

techs.quote: Throw the hammer. Call it back. Throw it again. Repeat until the enemy stops. — Muradin Bronzebeard

techs.name: Steam Power
uniques: [+1] Movement <for [Embarked] units>

civilopediaText.text: Steam that drives ships, engines and goblin contraptions.

techs.quote: The kettle sings, and the engine roars. — Gnomeregan workshop sign

techs.name: Seaforium

civilopediaText.text: Goblin seaforium charges, explosive enough to blow open any wall.

techs.quote: Handle with care. Then handle with more care. Then run. — Goblin demolitions crew

techs.name: Frost Enchantment
uniques: [-75]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Enchantments of frost that keep food fresh and ships' holds cold.

techs.quote: Cold is patient. Cold always wins. — Frostwolf shaman

techs.name: Communication Crystals
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Crystals that carry voices across great distances.

techs.quote: Speak into the crystal. Clearly. No, the other end. — Kirin Tor apprentice

techs.name: Gnomish Gearworks
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Standard gnomish parts that let machines be built and repaired quickly.

techs.quote: Small gears turn big wheels. Small gnomes build big machines. — Gnomish engineering motto

techs.name: Gnomish Flight

civilopediaText.text: Gyrocopters and flying machines take to the skies.

techs.quote: Up is the easy part. Down is where we need more work. — Gnomish test pilot

techs.name: Tramways
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Rails and steam wagons, like the Deeprun Tram beneath the mountains.

techs.quote: The Deeprun Tram: because tunnelling under the sea seemed sensible at the time. — Ironforge engineer

techs.name: Arcanite Alloys
uniques: [+200]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Arcanite, a transmuted metal lighter and stronger than any other.

techs.quote: Arcanite is what happens when you ask the arcane to hold still. — Thorium Brotherhood smith

techs.name: Arcane Conduits

civilopediaText.text: Wires and conduits that carry arcane power to machines.

techs.quote: Channel the ley lines, and a city never sleeps. — Silvermoon magister

techs.name: Fragmentation Shards

civilopediaText.text: Explosive shells that burst into shards, an artillery upgrade.

techs.quote: It is not the explosion that gets you. It is all the little pieces. — Dark Iron demolitionist

techs.name: Liquid Fire
uniques: [-50]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: The Horde's liquid fire, which burns even stone, and the engines it powers.

techs.quote: Burn the field, and the enemy has nowhere to stand. — Blood Elf battlemage

techs.name: Elixir Mastery

civilopediaText.text: Potions and elixirs that heal wounds and cure plagues.

techs.quote: Drink this. Do not ask what is in it. — Goblin alchemist

techs.name: Mana Theory
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Understanding the raw mana that flows through all things.

techs.quote: Mana is the blood of magic. Spill too much, and something hungry will come to drink it. — Khadgar

techs.name: Scrying
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Crystal balls and far sight to watch enemy armies from afar.

techs.quote: Peer into the orb and see what the enemy plans. Try not to let it see you back. — Dalaran seer

techs.name: Battle Formations

civilopediaText.text: Armies of many arms fighting as one.

techs.quote: A line of shields is a wall that walks. — Alliance drill sergeant

techs.name: Nature's Blessing

civilopediaText.text: Living in balance with the land, as the Cenarion Circle teaches.

techs.quote: Ask the trees for help, and they will answer. Slowly. — Keeper of the Grove

techs.name: Unstable Mana

civilopediaText.text: Mana pushed to the breaking point: the secret of the mana bomb.

techs.quote: Never store it near anything you would miss. — Mana Bomb project notes

techs.name: Demolition
uniques: [+100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Rockets and explosives for the battlefield.

techs.quote: If you can't go through it, blow it up. If you can go through it, blow it up anyway. — Goblin sapper

techs.name: Titan Logic

civilopediaText.text: The thinking machines of the titans, studied and copied at last.

techs.quote: The titans built the world as a machine. Now we are learning how to repair it. — Keeper Loken's records

techs.name: Portal Networks

civilopediaText.text: Portals and waystones linking every city in the realm.

techs.quote: Step through a portal in Stormwind, step out in Dalaran. Keep your arms and legs inside. — Portal trainer

techs.name: War Drums

civilopediaText.text: War drums that keep armies moving fast and fighting hard.

techs.quote: When the drums beat, every orc remembers who he is. — Thrall

techs.name: Siege Barrage

civilopediaText.text: Long-range bombardment by siege engines and airships.

techs.quote: Bring every cannon. Then bring more. — Horde siege commander

techs.name: Eye of Kilrogg
uniques: Reveals the entire map
[+200]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: The orc warlock's floating eye, an all-seeing spy in the sky.

techs.quote: What the eye sees, the warlock knows. — Gul'dan

techs.name: Mechagnomics

civilopediaText.text: Mechanical bodies and mechagnomes, the craft of Mechagon.

techs.quote: Flesh is weak. Gears are forever. — King Mechagon

techs.name: Focused Arcana
uniques: [-100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Beams of focused arcane power that cut through any armour.

techs.quote: A single beam of focused will can split a mountain. Please do not split our mountain. — Kirin Tor lecturer

techs.name: Azerothian Unity
uniques: [-100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: The peoples of Azeroth bound together by trade and need.

techs.quote: Alliance and Horde, standing together. Who would have believed it? — Baine Bloodhoof

techs.name: Azerite Refinement

civilopediaText.text: Refining Azerite, the lifeblood of the world, into power.

techs.quote: Azeroth bleeds Azerite. We must decide what to do with her blood. — Magni Bronzebeard

techs.name: Titanforging
uniques: [-100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: The titans' own forging, the power to shape matter itself.

techs.quote: Forge as the titans forged, and what you make will outlast the stars. — Keeper of Ulduar

techs.name: Ethereal Technology

civilopediaText.text: The secrets of the ethereals, beings of pure energy.

techs.quote: Everything has a price, even the impossible. — Consortium broker

techs.name: Invisibility
uniques: [-100]% weight to this choice for AI decisions

civilopediaText.text: Spells and devices that hide whole armies from sight.

techs.quote: You cannot strike what you cannot see. That is the whole point. — Ravenholdt master

techs.name: Secrets of the Void
uniques: Can be continually researched

civilopediaText.text: What secrets lie beyond the Void?

techs.quote: Gaze into the Void, and it gazes back, and whispers your name. — Xal'atath
